user.title: Set up Codex Bridge
user.description: Use the Home Assistant App for the private, recommended setup. External Bridge is an advanced legacy compatibility option.

app.title: Install or start the Codex Bridge App
app.description: Install the Codex Bridge App in Home Assistant Community Apps, start it, then retry. Home Assistant will discover its private endpoint and credentials automatically.

external.title: Connect an external legacy Bridge
external.description: Advanced compatibility setup. This accepts only a private legacy API v0 Bridge; use the Home Assistant App for current Codex features.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the discovered Codex Bridge App
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered {name}. Confirm to validate its private endpoint and add the Integration; retry if the App is temporarily unavailable.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect the Codex Bridge App
reauth_confirm.description: The Codex Bridge App rejected Home Assistant's saved connection details. Restart the App from Settings > Apps so it publishes fresh details; Home Assistant then reconnects and closes this request. If this request stays open, submit to check the connection again. A reinstalled App has a new identity: delete this Codex Bridge entry, restart the App, then confirm the newly discovered App.

reauth_external.title: Update the external Bridge token
reauth_external.description: The external Bridge rejected its saved token. Enter its current token; the saved endpoint is unchanged.

data_description.bridge_token: The token configured in your external Bridge. It replaces the saved token.

init.title: Codex Bridge settings
init.description: Choose task permissions and optionally expose a dedicated project to Assist. Assist reads that workspace and uses only its selected MCP servers, without web search or host access. Selected servers may control devices or services; configure their permissions in Codex Bridge MCP settings. Voice has no verified HA identity and needs separate consent. Question notices are off by default. Choose registered administrator devices for replies; generic notices keep question text private unless previews are enabled. Complex questions open the chat. Notification replies never approve execution or access.
